name: Avail
positioning: DIY landlord tooling with the distribution of a national portal behind it.
description: Avail gives independent landlords listing syndication, online applications, credit and background screening, state-specific lease agreements, digital signatures, rent collection with credit reporting for tenants, and maintenance tracking. Owned by Realtor.com.
real_estate_use: The distribution matters: a unit listed in Avail appears on Realtor.com and partner sites, so a landlord with two properties reaches the same audience as a management company. Rent payments can be reported to credit bureaus, which landlords use as an incentive for on-time payment.
features: Listing syndication through the Realtor.com network
Online applications with credit, criminal and eviction screening
State-specific lease agreements with digital signing
Rent collection with optional credit bureau reporting
Rent price analysis for a given address

use_cases.job: List a unit on a national portal and take applications without an agent
Build credit history by having on-time rent reported to the bureaus
